 NPL Final Draws Large Crowd at TU Cricket Ground
 Ratopati
 November 21, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. A significant crowd of spectators has gathered at the Tribhuvan University Cricket Ground in Kirtipur to watch the final match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket. The stadium is packed with spectators during the title clash between Lumbini Lions and Sudurpashchim Royals.
 The drone footage shows the TU Cricket Ground and its surrounding areas are densely populated with spectators. The enthusiasm, hooting, and hustle of the spectators who have come to support their respective teams have created a very exciting and cricket-centric atmosphere in the stadium.
